description: This file contains a CSS parser implementation, including tokenization, parsing CSS selectors, handling errors, and serializing selectors. It defines classes, functions, and types related to CSS selector parsing and processing.

classes.name: InvalidSelectorError
classes.description: Custom error class for invalid CSS selectors.

methods.name: isInvalidSelectorError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an instance of InvalidSelectorError.

methods.name: parseCSS
methods.description: Parses a CSS selector string into a structured selector object, handling tokens and errors.

methods.name: serializeSelector
methods.description: Serializes CSS function arguments back into a string representation.
